qr_plate:

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

This eliminates mid-air circular perimeters and prevents loose loops around the hole while preserving the flat bolt-head seat and the outer dovetail geometry.","parts":[{"print_orientation":"Bottom face of the plate on the build plate (z = 0), camera deck at z = 11 mm; counterbore ceiling uses two-stage sequential bridging to print cleanly without supports.","id":"qr_plate","role":"final","code":"def build(p):
    import math
    rad = math.radians(p.dovetail_angle)
    lip_inset = p.dovetail_lip_h / math.tan(rad)
    top_w = p.dovetail_base_w - 2.0 * lip_inset

    web_t = p.bolt_shaft_l - p.camera_thread_engagement
    cbore_h = p.bolt_head_h + p.head_recess_margin
    plate_h = web_t + cbore_h

    bolt_hole_d = p.bolt_d + p.bolt_clearance
    head_pocket_d = p.bolt_head_d + p.bolt_head_clearance

    pts = [
        (-p.dovetail_base_w / 2.0, 0.0),
        (p.dovetail_base_w / 2.0, 0.0),
        (top_w / 2.0, p.dovetail_lip_h),
        (top_w / 2.0, plate_h),
        (-top_w / 2.0, plate_h),
        (-top_w / 2.0, p.dovetail_lip_h),
    ]

    body = (
        cq.Workplane("YZ")
        .polyline(pts)
        .close()
        .extrude(p.plate_l / 2.0, both=True)
    )

    cbore = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(head_pocket_d / 2.0).extrude(cbore_h)

    bridge_stage1 = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=cbore_h)
        .rect(head_pocket_d, bolt_hole_d)
        .extrude(p.bridge_step_h)
        .intersect(
            cq.Workplane("XY")
            .workplane(offset=cbore_h)
            .circle(head_pocket_d / 2.0)
            .extrude(p.bridge_step_h)
        )
    )

    bridge_stage2 = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=cbore_h + p.bridge_step_h)
        .rect(bolt_hole_d, bolt_hole_d)
        .extrude(p.bridge_step_h)
    )

    thru_hole = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=cbore_h + 2.0 * p.bridge_step_h)
        .circle(bolt_hole_d / 2.0)
        .extrude(plate_h - (cbore_h + 2.0 * p.bridge_step_h))
    )

    return body.cut(cbore).cut(bridge_stage1).cut(bridge_stage2).cut(thru_hole)
